description: Single-DGX Spark DiffSynth disk-offload variant of Wan-Dancer's global-planning and local-refinement pipeline. Pinned DiffSynth-Studio disk-maps each safetensors expert, uses a 64 GiB device-residency threshold, and runs the two stages in separate processes. Generation is bounded to 921,600 pixels. The declared 126 GB memory envelope fits Controller admission; prefer the original recipe unless the larger canvas is needed.
